{{Quote|Swinging the blade about the body in a blur of deflection and deadly attacks is one of the many Jar'Kai techniques.|Description of Rising Whirlwind|<ref name="The Price of Victory">{{SWGTCG|set=The Price of Victory|cardname=Rising Whirlwind}}</ref>}}
The '''Rising Whirlwind''' was a [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] maneuver employed by users of [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]]. Useful for deflecting [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Laser/Legends|shots]], it involved the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] wielder spinning his or her lightsabers around like an unstoppable tornado.
